  - text: S1
  - heading "Summary" [level=2]
  - text: Generated · 30-second read
  - paragraph: Regulation (EU) 2024/1157 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 April 2024 on shipments of waste, which amends Regulations (EU) No 1257/2013 and (EU) 2020/1056 and repeals Regulation (EC) No 1013/2006, and is the primary EU instrument governing transboundary movement of waste intra-EU, on export, on import, and in transit, referencing the Basel Convention of 22 March 1989 and the related OECD Council Decision on transboundary waste movements. It applies within the European Union.
  - text: S2
  - heading "Obligations — issues requiring action" [level=2]
  - paragraph:
    - strong: "Action:"
    - text: Assess all current and planned export flows of waste to non-OECD countries, including recyclables classified as waste, against the prohibition and listing requirements of Articles 39–43.
  - paragraph: ANALYTICAL INFERENCE
  - paragraph: Operational implication
  - paragraph: From 21 May 2027, exports of non-hazardous (green-listed) waste to non-OECD countries will be prohibited unless the destination country has been included in the Commission's list of authorised countries established under Article 41. The deadline for non-OECD countries to submit their initial inclusion requests was 21 February 2025.
  - paragraph: From 21 November 2026 (earlier than the general export-rules date), exports of plastic waste classified under entry B3011 to non-OECD countries are prohibited under Article 39(1)(d).
  - paragraph: Industry bodies have flagged that many non-OECD countries were not ready by the 21 February 2025 request deadline, and that existing business relationships for recycled material exports could be disrupted if the first authorised-country list (planned for adoption by 21 November 2026) does not include key destination countries.
